# OmniTrader strategy reference

## Blueprint (kind=blueprint) — JSON
Fields: inputs[] {name,label,type:int|double|bool,default,min,max,step} · universe {mode:single|basket|universe, symbol, symbols[], topN, quoteAsset, regimeSymbol} · direction long|short|both · rules {entryLong, exitLong, entryShort, exitShort, filter} (each a ConditionGroup) · sizing {mode:percent|quote|risk|voltarget, value, maxPositions, maxPositionPct} · risk {stopLoss, takeProfit, trailing: {mode:none|percent|atr|r, value, atrLength}, maxBarsInTrade, cooldownBars, exitOnFilterOff} · ranking {score (formula), top, bottom, rebalanceBars, weighting:equal|inverse-vol|score, grossExposure, minDollarVolume}.
ConditionGroup {logic:all|any, negate, conditions[]}. Condition {kind:compare|group|formula, left, op, right, right2, bars, group, formula}. ops: > >= < <= == != crosses_above crosses_below rising falling between outside. bars>1 on a comparison = held for N bars.
Operand {kind:indicator|price|value|input|formula, indicator, params{input:value or input name}, output, field, value, input, formula, offset (bars ago ≥0), scale}.
Sizing: percent = % of equity per position; risk = % of equity lost at the stop (needs stopLoss); voltarget = target annual vol % per position. filter in basket/universe mode is evaluated on regimeSymbol. Shorts only execute with leverage > 1.
Example single-symbol: {"inputs":[{"name":"fast","type":"int","default":20,"min":5,"max":100}],"universe":{"mode":"single","symbol":"BTCUSDT"},"rules":{"entryLong":{"logic":"all","conditions":[{"kind":"compare","left":{"kind":"indicator","indicator":"ema","params":{"length":"fast"}},"op":"crosses_above","right":{"kind":"indicator","indicator":"ema","params":{"length":50}}}]},"exitLong":{"logic":"all","conditions":[{"kind":"formula","formula":"crossunder(ema(close, fast), ema(close, 50))"}]}},"sizing":{"mode":"percent","value":95},"risk":{"stopLoss":{"mode":"atr","value":3,"atrLength":14}}}
Example rotation: {"universe":{"mode":"universe","topN":30,"regimeSymbol":"BTCUSDT"},"rules":{"filter":{"conditions":[{"kind":"formula","formula":"close > sma(close, 100)"}]}},"ranking":{"score":"roc(close, 30)","top":5,"rebalanceBars":7,"weighting":"inverse-vol","grossExposure":0.95}}

## Script (kind=script) — C#
Derive from ScriptStrategy (one symbol: override void OnBar()) or ScriptUniverseStrategy (many: override void OnBar(UniverseView u), call SetWeights(dict of signed weights)). Optional [TradingStrategy("Name","Description")] on the class; [Param("Label", Min=, Max=, Step=)] on public settable properties makes them inputs. Usings for System, Linq, Collections, the trading API are implicit.
ScriptStrategy: Close/Open/High/Low/Volume, C(ago)/O/H/L/V, Time, CurrentBar; indicators Sma/Ema/Wma/Hma(n,ago), Rsi, Atr, Natr, Adx, Cci, Mfi, WilliamsR, Roc, StdDev, ZScore, PercentRank, Highest, Lowest, Vwap, Obv, HistVol, Ibs, Macd(f,s,sig)→(Line,Signal,Hist), Bollinger(n,k)→(Upper,Mid,Lower), Keltner, Donchian, Stoch→(K,D), Supertrend→(Line,Direction), F("any formula", ago), CrossAbove("a","b"), CrossBelow; position PositionSize, IsLong, IsShort, IsFlat, EntryPrice, BarsInTrade, OpenProfitPct, Cash, AccountEquity, MaxLeverage, HasPendingOrders; orders Buy(qty, sl, tp), Sell, BuyPercent(pct, sl, tp), ShortPercent, SetTargetPercent(signed pct), ExitLong(), ExitShort(), Exit(), LimitBuy/LimitSell(qty, price), StopBuy/StopSell(qty, stop), SetStopLoss(price), SetTakeProfit(price); Plot(name, value); Print(msg); override Initialize() and OnFill(FillEvent).
ScriptUniverseStrategy: properties UniverseSize, RegimeSymbol, BarNumber; override Symbols for a fixed basket; UniverseView u: u.Symbols, u.Time, u.Close(sym, ago), u.Volume(sym, ago), u.F(sym, formula, ago), u.Bars(sym); Holdings, AccountEquity, MaxLeverage, Plot.
Sandbox: no I/O, network, reflection, threads/Task.Run, processes, Environment, Console, DateTime.Now (use Time), unsafe/stackalloc/goto/finalizers, nothing in Omnipotent outside the trading API. Loops and recursion are budgeted per callback. Orders queued in OnBar submit after it returns; market orders fill next bar's open in evaluations.

## Formula language (blueprint formulas, ranking scores, F(), screens)
Series: open high low close volume hl2 hlc3 ohlc4 hlcc4 bar_index time. Operators: + - * / % ^, > >= < <= == !=, and or not, cond ? a : b, x[n] (n bars ago, n ≥ 0), f(...).output. Booleans are 1/0; na during warm-up.
Functions: crossover(a, b); crossunder(a, b); cross(a, b); rising(x, n); falling(x, n); highest(x, n); lowest(x, n); highestbars(x, n); lowestbars(x, n); sum(x, n); avg(x, n); change(x, n=1); pctchange(x, n=1); ref(x, n); barssince(cond); valuewhen(cond, x, n=0); streak(cond); corr(a, b, n); beta(a, b, n); abs(x); sign(x); sqrt(x); log(x); log10(x); exp(x); floor(x); ceil(x); round(x, digits=0); pow(a, b); min(a, b, …); max(a, b, …); clamp(x, lo, hi); nz(x, v=0); na(x); iff(cond, a, b); hour(); minute(); dayofweek(); dayofmonth(); month(); year(); ext("SYMBOL", "close")
Indicators (source can be omitted: rsi(14) = rsi(close, 14); named args allowed: bb(close, 20, mult=2.5)):
- sma(src, length=20) — Simple Moving Average
- ema(src, length=20) — Exponential Moving Average
- wma(src, length=20) — Weighted Moving Average
- rma(src, length=14) — Wilder Moving Average
- dema(src, length=20) — Double EMA
- tema(src, length=20) — Triple EMA
- hma(src, length=21) — Hull Moving Average
- zlema(src, length=20) — Zero-Lag EMA
- mcginley(src, length=14) — McGinley Dynamic
- lsma(src, length=25) — Least Squares MA
- kama(src, length=10, fast=2, slow=30) — Kaufman Adaptive MA
- alma(src, length=9, offset=0.85, sigma=6) — Arnaud Legoux MA
- vwma(src, length=20) — Volume-Weighted MA
- t3(src, length=5, vfactor=0.7) — Tillson T3
- vwap(anchor=Session) — VWAP (anchored)
- rvwap(length=50) — Rolling VWAP
- bb(src, length=20, mult=2) → .mid .upper .lower — Bollinger Bands
- bbpct(src, length=20, mult=2) — Bollinger %B
- bbw(src, length=20, mult=2) — Bollinger Bandwidth
- kc(length=20, mult=2, atrLength=10) → .mid .upper .lower — Keltner Channels
- dc(length=20) → .upper .lower .mid — Donchian Channels
- supertrend(length=10, mult=3) → .line .dir — Supertrend
- psar(step=0.02, max=0.2) — Parabolic SAR
- ichimoku(conversion=9, base=26, spanB=52, displacement=26) → .tenkan .kijun .spanA .spanB .chikou — Ichimoku Cloud
- pivots(style=Classic) → .p .r1 .r2 .s1 .s2 — Pivot Points (daily)
- swings(left=5, right=5) → .high .low — Swing Highs / Lows
- linreg(src, length=50) — Linear Regression
- rsi(src, length=14) — Relative Strength Index
- stoch(length=14, smoothK=3, d=3) → .k .d — Stochastic
- stochrsi(src, rsiLength=14, length=14, smoothK=3, d=3) → .k .d — Stochastic RSI
- cci(src, length=20) — Commodity Channel Index
- willr(length=14) — Williams %R
- mfi(length=14) — Money Flow Index
- uo(fast=7, mid=14, slow=28) — Ultimate Oscillator
- ao(fast=5, slow=34) — Awesome Oscillator
- macd(src, fast=12, slow=26, signal=9) → .macd .signal .hist — MACD
- ppo(src, fast=12, slow=26, signal=9) → .ppo .signal .hist — Percentage Price Oscillator
- cmo(src, length=9) — Chande Momentum Oscillator
- tsi(src, long=25, short=13, signal=13) → .tsi .signal — True Strength Index
- fisher(length=9) → .fisher .trigger — Fisher Transform
- crsi(src, rsiLength=3, streakLength=2, rankLength=100) — Connors RSI
- coppock(src, wma=10, longRoc=14, shortRoc=11) — Coppock Curve
- roc(src, length=10) — Rate of Change
- mom(src, length=10) — Momentum
- trix(src, length=15) — TRIX
- dpo(src, length=20) — Detrended Price Oscillator
- kst(src) → .kst .signal — Know Sure Thing
- adx(length=14) → .adx .pdi .mdi — Average Directional Index
- aroon(length=25) → .up .down .osc — Aroon
- vortex(length=14) → .plus .minus — Vortex Indicator
- chop(length=14) — Choppiness Index
- trendscore(fast=20, slow=50) — Trend Score
- atr(length=14) — Average True Range
- natr(length=14) — Normalized ATR
- tr() — True Range
- stdev(src, length=20) — Standard Deviation
- hv(length=20) — Historical Volatility
- parkinson(length=20) — Parkinson Volatility
- gkvol(length=20) — Garman-Klass Volatility
- ulcer(length=14) — Ulcer Index
- chaikinvol(length=10, roc=10) — Chaikin Volatility
- squeeze(length=20, bbMult=2, kcMult=1.5) — Bollinger/Keltner Squeeze
- volume(length=20) → .value .ma — Volume
- obv() — On-Balance Volume
- ad() — Accumulation/Distribution
- cmf(length=20) — Chaikin Money Flow
- chaikinosc(fast=3, slow=10) — Chaikin Oscillator
- fi(length=13) — Force Index
- eom(length=14) — Ease of Movement
- pvt() — Price-Volume Trend
- klinger(fast=34, slow=55, signal=13) → .kvo .signal — Klinger Oscillator
- relvol(length=20) — Relative Volume
- volosc(fast=5, slow=10) — Volume Oscillator
- dollarvol(length=20) — Dollar Volume
- zscore(src, length=20) — Z-Score
- percentrank(src, length=100) — Percent Rank
- slope(src, length=20) — Regression Slope
- r2(src, length=20) — Regression R²
- skew(src, length=60) — Rolling Skew (returns)
- kurt(src, length=60) — Rolling Excess Kurtosis (returns)
- hurst(src, length=100) — Hurst Exponent
- autocorr(src, length=60, lag=1) — Return Autocorrelation
- rsharpe(length=60) — Rolling Sharpe
- drawdown() — Drawdown from High
- ibs() — Internal Bar Strength
- gap() — Opening Gap %
- doji() — Doji
- hammer() — Hammer / Shooting Star
- engulfing() — Engulfing
- insidebar() — Inside Bar
- outsidebar() — Outside Bar
- soldiers() — Three Soldiers / Crows
